# Application conditions

Where a principle was applied differently depending on the situation, or where sources word a credit differently, the research records it here. Read these as conditions for applying the principle well, not as criticism of anyone. Each entry gives only what changes how the lens is used; the source-by-source record stays in the research data. Never use these entries for commentary on any person or dispute.
